mannered.zh: 舉止有禮的；矯揉造作的
ai: He was a soft-spoken and well mannered young man.
他是個說話輕聲細語、舉止有禮的年輕人。
The actor's mannered style made the performance feel stiff and unnatural.
那位演員矯揉造作的風格讓表演顯得僵硬不自然。
Atheism is the belief that no gods exist.
無神論是相信沒有神存在的想法。
She wrote an essay comparing atheism with other worldviews.
她寫了一篇比較無神論與其他世界觀的文章。
The people finally rose up against the tyrannical king.
人民終於起身反抗那位暴虐的國王。
My tyrannical boss expects us to answer emails at midnight.
我那個專橫的老闆要求我們半夜也要回電子郵件。
The holiday dinner gave the whole family a sense of togetherness.
這頓節日晚餐讓全家人有了親密相聚的感覺。
Teamwork and togetherness helped us finish the project on time.
團隊合作與團結一心讓我們如期完成了專案。
Washing dishes by hand every night felt like pure drudgery.
每晚用手洗碗感覺根本就是苦差事。
She escaped the drudgery of office work by starting her own business.
她創業來擺脫辦公室工作的枯燥乏味。
The old church has a beautiful vaulted ceiling.
那座老教堂有漂亮的拱形天花板。
We walked through a long vaulted corridor to reach the library.
我們穿過一條長長的拱頂走廊才到圖書館。
He was fired for disloyalty after sharing company secrets.
他因為洩漏公司機密、不忠誠而被開除。
Switching sides in the middle of the game felt like disloyalty to his teammates.
在比賽中途換邊讓他覺得對不起隊友，像是背叛。
She turned out to be a clever manipulator who always got her way.
她原來是個善於操弄別人、總能如願的人。
Be careful with him, he is a skilled manipulator.
要小心他，他很會操控別人。
The baby gave a lusty cry as soon as he was born.
嬰兒一出生就發出響亮有力的哭聲。
The farmers sang a lusty song as they worked in the field.
農夫們在田裡一邊工作一邊精神飽滿地唱歌。
The sponge quickly absorbed all the spilled water.
海綿很快就把灑出來的水都吸乾了。
The company absorbed the extra costs instead of raising prices.
公司自行吸收了額外的成本，沒有漲價。
She was so absorbed in her book that she missed her stop.
她看書看得太入迷，結果坐過站了。
The children were completely absorbed in the video game.
孩子們完全沉浸在電玩遊戲裡。
The school has a strict policy against homophobic language.
學校對恐同的言語有嚴格的規定。
He apologized for making a homophobic remark online.
他為在網路上發表恐同言論而道歉。
The plan has been in abeyance since the budget was cut.
預算被刪減後，這項計畫就一直擱置著。
The old rule fell into abeyance and nobody enforces it anymore.
那條舊規定已經失效，沒有人再執行了。
A Yorkshireman is someone who comes from Yorkshire in northern England.
約克郡人指的是來自英格蘭北部約克郡的人。
The tour guide was a proud Yorkshireman who loved talking about his home county.
導遊是個以家鄉為傲的約克郡人，很愛聊他的故鄉。
That restaurant is nice but a bit pricy for a student.
那家餐廳不錯，但對學生來說有點貴。
I found a pricy jacket on sale and bought it right away.
我看到一件原本很貴的外套在特價，就馬上買了。
The farmer piled the dry grass into a huge haystack.
農夫把乾草堆成一座巨大的草堆。
Finding one typo in this long report is like finding a needle in a haystack.
要在這份長報告裡找出一個錯字，就像大海撈針。
The cat moved with feline grace across the room.
那隻貓以優雅的姿態穿過房間。
Lions and tigers are large feline predators.
獅子和老虎是大型的貓科掠食動物。
The vet specializes in treating felines.
這位獸醫專門治療貓科動物。
The zoo has a new exhibit featuring wild felines from Asia.
動物園有個新展區展出來自亞洲的野生貓科動物。
He vainly tried to start the old car in the cold.
他在寒冷的天氣裡徒勞地想發動那輛老車。
She waited vainly for a reply to her letter.
她白白等了很久，卻一直沒收到信的回覆。
The word was once neutral but now has a pejorative meaning.
這個字以前是中性的，現在卻帶有貶義。
He disliked the pejorative tone of the article.
他不喜歡那篇文章輕蔑的語氣。
Some people use that term as a pejorative.
有些人把那個詞當作貶義詞來用。
The teacher explained why the word is considered a pejorative.
老師解釋了為什麼那個字被視為貶義詞。
"Jumbo shrimp" is a funny example of an oxymoron.
「巨大的小蝦」是矛盾修飾法的有趣例子。
Some people think "working vacation" is an oxymoron.
有些人覺得「工作假期」是個自相矛盾的詞。
He had an undistinguished career as a clerk.
他當了一輩子平凡無奇的職員。
The restaurant serves undistinguished food at high prices.
這家餐廳賣的是普通無奇卻價格不低的食物。
The bowman pulled back the string and aimed at the target.
弓箭手拉開弓弦，瞄準靶心。
A skilled bowman could hit a target from far away.
技術好的弓箭手可以射中遠處的目標。

unawares.zh: 出其不意地；不知不覺地
ai: The sudden question caught me unawares.
這個突如其來的問題讓我措手不及。
The rain took the hikers unawares and they got soaked.
這場雨來得出其不意，登山客全被淋濕了。
It would be presumptuous of me to give advice on your marriage.
我對你的婚姻給意見就太冒昧了。
He seemed presumptuous when he sat down at the head of the table.
他一屁股坐在主位上，顯得很放肆。
The servants were expected to be quiet and subservient.
僕人被要求安靜又順從。
She refused to be subservient to her boss's every whim.
她拒絕對老闆的一切怪念頭唯命是從。

unfolding.zh: 展開；攤開（unfold 的現在分詞）
ai: She sat on the bed unfolding the map.
她坐在床上攤開那張地圖。
The child watched the paper crane slowly unfolding in the water.
孩子看著紙鶴在水中慢慢展開。
We watched the unfolding drama with great interest.
我們興致勃勃地看著事情逐步發展的戲劇性經過。
Reporters are covering the unfolding story live.
記者正在現場報導這則持續發展的新聞。
The photo came out blurry and unfocused.
這張照片拍出來模糊又失焦。
After a sleepless night, I felt tired and unfocused at work.
一夜沒睡後，我上班時又累又無法專心。
The war had a ruinous effect on the country's economy.
戰爭對該國經濟造成毀滅性的影響。
Borrowing money at such a high rate would be ruinous.
以那麼高的利率借錢會讓人傾家蕩產。
The waves left a white froth on the sand.
海浪在沙灘上留下白色的泡沫。
He wiped the milk froth off his upper lip.
他擦掉上唇的奶泡。
The river frothed as it rushed over the rocks.
河水衝過岩石時泛起泡沫。
Pour in the soda and watch it froth up.
倒入汽水，看它冒出泡沫。
The singer received a rapturous welcome from the crowd.
歌手受到群眾狂熱的歡迎。
The film won rapturous applause at the festival.
這部電影在影展上贏得熱烈的掌聲。
The coach is good at motivating young players.
教練很擅長激勵年輕球員。
What is motivating you to learn a new language?
是什麼促使你想學一種新語言？
Winning the first match was a motivating experience for the team.
贏下第一場比賽對球隊來說是振奮人心的經驗。
A motivating speech can change how people feel about their work.
一場鼓舞人心的演講可以改變人們對工作的感受。

publicised.zh: 宣傳；公開（publicise 的過去式）
ai: The festival was widely publicised on social media.
這場慶典在社群媒體上廣為宣傳。
The company publicised its new policy last week.
公司上週公佈了新的政策。
My phone has a backlit screen that is easy to read at night.
我的手機有背光螢幕，晚上很好閱讀。
The photographer liked the backlit scene at sunset.
攝影師很喜歡日落時逆光的場景。
Don't let them pressurise you into signing the contract.
別讓他們逼你簽下合約。
The cabin is pressurised so passengers can breathe at high altitude.
機艙有加壓，乘客在高空才能呼吸。
He works long hours for a mere pittance.
他工時很長，薪水卻微薄得可憐。
The old furniture sold for a pittance at the sale.
那些舊家具在拍賣會上以極低的價錢賣出。
A huge conflagration destroyed the old warehouse district.
一場大火燒毀了舊倉庫區。
Firefighters struggled to control the conflagration in the forest.
消防員奮力控制森林裡的大火。

overstuffed.zh: 塞得太滿的；填充得鬆軟的
ai: I tripped over her overstuffed suitcase in the hallway.
我在走廊被她塞得滿滿的行李箱絆倒。
They sat on an overstuffed sofa and watched TV.
他們坐在又軟又厚的沙發上看電視。
The commandant inspected the troops at the military academy.
司令官視察了軍校的部隊。
The new commandant gave a short speech to the cadets.
新任指揮官對學員發表了簡短的談話。
She invited all her classmates to her birthday party.
她邀請了所有同學來參加她的生日派對。
We were invited to dinner at our neighbor's house.
我們受邀到鄰居家吃晚餐。
She wore a warm quilted jacket in the winter.
她冬天穿著保暖的絎縫外套。
The bed was covered with a colorful quilted blanket.
床上蓋著一條色彩繽紛的拼布被。
The doctor checked the foetal heartbeat during the exam.
醫師在檢查時聽了胎兒的心跳。
She slept curled up in a foetal position.
她蜷縮成胎兒的姿勢睡覺。
The scorched grass showed where the fire had passed.
燒焦的草地顯示火燒過的地方。
The kitchen smelled of scorched toast.
廚房裡有烤焦吐司的味道。
The hot iron scorched my favorite shirt.
熱熨斗把我最愛的襯衫燙焦了。
The summer sun scorched the fields and ruined the crops.
夏天的烈日曬焦了田地，毀了作物。
The meeting turned into a farcical argument about nothing.
這場會議變成一場為芝麻小事吵來吵去的荒唐鬧劇。
The trial was so farcical that people laughed out loud.
那場審判荒唐到讓人笑出聲來。
He carries a small stone as a lucky talisman.
他帶著一顆小石頭當作幸運護身符。
The old coin served as a talisman against bad luck.
那枚舊硬幣被當作避邪的護身符。
He sells old toys and other collectibles online.
他在網路上賣舊玩具和其他收藏品。
The shop is full of rare collectibles from the 1960s.
那家店擺滿了六〇年代的珍稀收藏品。
Glasnost was a policy of greater openness in the Soviet Union.
開放政策是蘇聯推行的一項更公開透明的政策。
Our history teacher explained how glasnost changed Soviet society.
歷史老師解釋了開放政策如何改變蘇聯社會。
The streets were disturbingly quiet after the storm.
暴風雨後街上安靜得令人不安。
The test results were disturbingly low.
測驗結果低得令人擔憂。
Critics accused the school of elitism because it only accepted top students.
批評者指責這所學校搞菁英主義，只收頂尖學生。
He believes elitism makes ordinary people feel left out.
他認為菁英主義會讓一般人覺得被排除在外。
The restaurant is famous for its slow-cooked beef brisket.
這家餐廳以慢火燉煮的牛胸肉聞名。
We served sliced brisket with potatoes at dinner.
我們晚餐端出切片的牛胸肉配馬鈴薯。
Many people complain about the commercialism of the holiday season.
許多人抱怨節慶季節太過商業化。
The artist rejected commercialism and refused to sell out.
那位藝術家拒絕商業主義，不肯為錢妥協。
She is coordinating the school trip for 100 students.
她正在統籌一百名學生的校外旅行。
Coordinating everyone's schedules takes a lot of time.
協調每個人的時間表要花很多時間。
He lived as a drifter, moving from town to town.
他過著漂泊的生活，從一個小鎮搬到另一個小鎮。
The old drifter asked if he could sleep in the barn.
那位老流浪漢問能不能睡在穀倉裡。
The small shop hired a bookkeeper to manage its accounts.
這家小店僱了一位記帳員來管帳。
My aunt works as a bookkeeper for a local company.
我阿姨在一家本地公司當記帳員。
The assistant ably handled the difficult customers.
助理很有能力地處理了難纏的客人。
She was ably supported by a talented team.
她有一支能幹的團隊在一旁協助她。
Volunteering is a prosocial behavior that helps the community.
當志工是對社區有益的親社會行為。
The program teaches children prosocial skills like sharing and helping.
這個課程教孩子分享與幫助他人等親社會技能。

unsuspected.zh: 意想不到的；未被懷疑的
ai: The old house hid an unsuspected room behind the wall.
那棟老房子牆後藏著一間意想不到的房間。
She had unsuspected talent as a painter.
她有著沒人料到的繪畫天分。
Breakfast is included in the price of the room.
房價已包含早餐。
Tax is not included, so you will pay a bit more.
價格不含稅，所以你要多付一點。
Some people love coriander, but others think it tastes like soap.
有些人愛香菜，也有人覺得它吃起來像肥皂。
Sprinkle fresh coriander on the soup before serving.
上桌前在湯上撒些新鮮香菜。
She decided to study obstetrics and become a doctor for pregnant women.
她決定學產科，成為照顧孕婦的醫師。
The hospital has a well-known obstetrics department.
這家醫院有一個知名的產科。
It was spiteful of him to tell everyone her secret.
他把她的祕密告訴大家，實在太惡毒了。
She made a spiteful comment about her sister's new haircut.
她對妹妹的新髮型說了一句惡意的話。

softening.zh: 使變柔軟（soften 的現在分詞）
ai: The sun was softening the butter on the table.
太陽讓桌上的奶油慢慢變軟。
Her voice was softening as she spoke to the child.
她對孩子說話時，語氣漸漸變得溫柔。
As a secularist, he believes government should stay separate from religion.
身為主張政教分離的人，他認為政府應與宗教分開。
The secularist group asked the school to end the prayer session.
那個主張政教分離的團體要求學校取消祈禱時間。
Keeping animals in tiny cages is inhumane.
把動物關在狹小的籠子裡是不人道的。
The prisoners complained about the inhumane conditions.
囚犯抱怨牢房的待遇不人道。
The city promised to rehouse families who lost their homes in the flood.
市政府承諾重新安置在洪水中失去家園的家庭。
The charity works to rehouse people who were living on the street.
這個慈善機構努力為流落街頭的人安排新住處。
The butcher removed the innards of the fish.
魚販把魚的內臟取出。
He opened the clock to look at its innards.
他打開時鐘，看看裡面的構造。
The racehorse ran faster than all the others.
那匹賽馬跑得比其他馬都快。
Her uncle owns a racehorse that has won several prizes.
她叔叔擁有一匹得過幾次獎的賽馬。
We rested on a shadowed path under the trees.
我們在樹下的陰涼小徑上休息。
His shadowed face was hard to see in the dim light.
在昏暗的光線下，他籠罩在陰影裡的臉很難看清楚。
There was a pile of unwashed dishes in the sink.
水槽裡堆著一疊沒洗的碗盤。
Wash the fruit first, because it is still unwashed.
水果還沒洗，要先洗過。

irreconcilable.zh: 無法調和的；不能和解的
ai: The couple divorced because of irreconcilable differences.
這對夫妻因為無法調和的歧見而離婚。
The two sides hold irreconcilable views on the issue.
雙方對這個議題的看法水火不容。
Perversely, the more he was told not to go, the more he wanted to.
偏偏別人越叫他不要去，他就越想去。
She perversely refused help even though she clearly needed it.
她明明需要幫忙卻偏偏不肯接受。
The two brothers argued without rancor.
兄弟倆爭論時並沒有怨恨。
Years later, she still felt rancor toward her old boss.
多年後，她對以前的老闆仍心懷怨恨。

narrowing.zh: 變窄；縮小（narrow 的現在分詞）
ai: The road is narrowing to one lane ahead.
前方道路縮減為單線車道。
The police are narrowing the search to a small area.
警方正把搜索範圍縮小到一小塊區域。
The doctor explained the symptoms of schizophrenic disorders to the family.
醫師向家屬說明思覺失調症的症狀。
The study followed schizophrenic patients over ten years.
這項研究追蹤思覺失調症患者長達十年。
A feeling of lethargy came over me after the big lunch.
吃完豐盛的午餐後，我感到昏昏欲睡。
Lethargy and loss of appetite can be signs of illness.
無精打采和食慾不振可能是生病的徵兆。
Early cells in the embryo are undifferentiated.
胚胎早期的細胞是未分化的。
The report treated all customers as an undifferentiated group.
這份報告把所有顧客當成沒有區別的同一群人。
A gaggle of geese crossed the road in front of our car.
一群鵝在我們車前過馬路。
A gaggle of tourists gathered around the guide.
一群吵吵鬧鬧的遊客圍在導遊身邊。
Methanol is a toxic liquid that should never be drunk.
甲醇是有毒的液體，絕對不能喝。
The factory uses methanol as a solvent in its production line.
工廠在生產線上用甲醇當溶劑。
The manager chose expediency over fairness and picked the fastest option.
經理選了最快的做法，把方便行事看得比公平重要。
Politicians are sometimes accused of acting out of expediency rather than principle.
政治人物有時被指責是出於權宜而非原則行事。

enabling.zh: 使能夠（enable 的現在分詞）
ai: The new software is enabling teachers to grade papers faster.
新軟體讓老師能更快批改作業。
Good roads are enabling farmers to reach the market easily.
良好的道路讓農民能輕鬆到達市場。
The company offers a mentoring program for new employees.
公司為新進員工提供師徒輔導計畫。
She gets great satisfaction from mentoring young students.
她從指導年輕學生中得到很大的成就感。
Rationalism is the idea that reason is the main source of knowledge.
理性主義認為理性是知識的主要來源。
The philosopher defended rationalism against emotional arguments.
那位哲學家為理性主義辯護，反駁訴諸情感的論點。
The new law could dispossess thousands of farmers of their land.
新法律可能讓數千名農民失去土地。
The family was dispossessed of their home after the war.
戰後這家人的房子被剝奪了。
Asked to work on Sunday, he did not demur.
被要求週日上班時，他沒有表示異議。
Several members demurred at the plan to raise fees.
幾位成員對調漲費用的計畫表示反對。
She agreed to the changes without demur.
她毫無異議地同意了那些改動。
The proposal was accepted with little demur.
這項提案幾乎沒有異議地獲得通過。
The campers dug a latrine far from the stream.
露營的人在遠離溪流的地方挖了一個簡易廁所。
Soldiers were told to keep the latrine clean.
士兵被要求保持茅廁乾淨。

mangled.zh: 嚴重損壞；弄爛（mangle 的過去式）
ai: The machine mangled my sleeve and almost pulled in my arm.
機器把我的袖子絞爛了，差點把我的手臂也捲進去。
The tourist mangled the pronunciation of the street name.
那位遊客把街名的發音念得亂七八糟。
She solved the puzzle with great cleverness.
她非常機靈地解開了那個謎題。
His cleverness helped him find a way out of trouble.
他的聰明才智幫他想到擺脫麻煩的辦法。
The waterlogged ground made it hard to walk across the field.
積滿水的地面讓人很難走過那片田地。
We could not light the waterlogged wood.
那些濕透了的木頭根本點不著。
Before email, companies sent messages by telex.
在有電子郵件之前，公司用電傳來傳遞訊息。
The old office still had a telex machine in the corner.
那間舊辦公室的角落還放著一台電傳打字機。
The train pulled a long line of boxcars through the valley.
火車拖著一長列貨車廂穿過山谷。
The workers loaded sacks of grain into the boxcar.
工人把一袋袋穀物搬上貨車廂。
I enjoy the quietness of the library in the morning.
我喜歡早上圖書館的寧靜。
The quietness of the village surprised the city visitors.
村子的寂靜讓來自城市的訪客感到驚訝。
He bent down to tie his shoestring.
他彎下身去綁鞋帶。
One broken shoestring made me late for school.
一條斷掉的鞋帶害我上學遲到了。
They started the business on a shoestring budget.
他們用極少的預算創辦了這門生意。
We traveled across Europe on a shoestring.
我們花很少的錢玩遍了歐洲。
The paymaster handed each worker an envelope on Friday.
出納員在週五把薪水袋交給每位工人。
The army paymaster kept careful records of every payment.
軍中的發薪官把每筆支出都仔細記錄下來。
A cold northerly wind blew across the lake.
一陣寒冷的北風吹過湖面。
We drove in a northerly direction for two hours.
我們朝北方開了兩個小時的車。
She dug a small hole with a garden trowel and planted the flower.
她用園藝小鏟挖了個小洞，把花種進去。
The builder smoothed the wet cement with a trowel.
工人用泥刀把濕水泥抹平。
They bought a small house on the beachfront.
他們在海濱買了一間小房子。
The beachfront is crowded with tourists in summer.
夏天海濱擠滿了遊客。
We stayed in a beachfront hotel with a lovely view.
我們住在一間臨海的旅館，景色很美。
Beachfront property is usually very expensive.
海濱的房地產通常非常昂貴。
The teacher asked us to retell the story in our own words.
老師要我們用自己的話重述這個故事。
My grandfather loves to retell his childhood adventures.
我爺爺很愛重複講他童年的冒險故事。
The marshy ground made it hard to build a road.
沼澤般的濕軟地面讓修路很困難。
Frogs and birds live in the marshy area near the river.
青蛙和鳥類生活在河邊的沼澤地帶。
I felt a stabbing pain in my side when I ran.
我跑步時側腹一陣刺痛。
A stabbing headache kept her up all night.
一陣劇烈的頭痛讓她整夜沒睡。
The film tells a redemptive story about a man who changes his life.
這部電影講述一個男人改變人生、重獲救贖的故事。
Many people see forgiveness as a redemptive act.
許多人把原諒視為一種帶來救贖的行為。
I like the informality of our weekly team meetings.
我喜歡我們每週團隊會議的隨性氣氛。
The informality of the party made everyone feel relaxed.
派對的隨興氣氛讓每個人都很放鬆。
A government functionary stamped the form and handed it back.
一位政府官員在表格上蓋章後把它還給我。
He was a minor functionary in the city office.
他是市政府裡一名小官員。
The little girl collected a seashell on the beach.
小女孩在海灘上撿了一個貝殼。
If you hold a seashell to your ear, you can hear a sound like the sea.
把貝殼貼近耳朵，你能聽見像海浪的聲音。
The company decided to realign its sales team with the new strategy.
公司決定讓業務團隊重新配合新策略做調整。
The mechanic had to realign the wheels after the accident.
車禍後技師得重新校正輪子。
We sat by the fireside and drank hot tea.
我們坐在火爐旁喝熱茶。
Grandma told stories at the fireside every winter night.
每個冬夜奶奶都在爐火旁說故事。
The teacher gave the paired students a task to complete together.
老師給兩人一組的學生一項要共同完成的作業。
The shop sells paired earrings in a small box.
這家店賣盒裝成對的耳環。
She was offered the directorship of the new research center.
她被邀請擔任新研究中心的主任。
He gave up his directorship to spend more time with his family.
他卸下董事職位，好多花時間陪家人。
The police ordered the crowd to desist and go home.
警方命令群眾停止行動並回家。
Please desist from smoking in this area.
請勿在此區域吸菸。
The weather vane on the roof turned toward the north.
屋頂上的風向標轉向北方。
The vanes of the windmill spun slowly in the breeze.
風車的葉片在微風中緩緩轉動。
We heard the clank of chains in the dark.
我們在黑暗中聽見鐵鍊的叮噹聲。
The door shut with a loud clank.
門伴隨著一聲響亮的鏗鏘聲關上。
The old pipes clank every time the heater turns on.
每次暖氣一開，老舊的水管就叮噹作響。
Her keys clanked against the metal gate.
她的鑰匙撞在鐵門上叮噹作響。
"As brave as a lion" is a common simile.
「像獅子一樣勇敢」是常見的明喻。
The poem uses a simile to compare the moon to a silver coin.
這首詩用明喻把月亮比作銀幣。
The vaunted new phone turned out to be disappointing.
那支被大肆吹捧的新手機結果令人失望。
The team's vaunted defense failed in the final game.
球隊引以為傲的防守在決賽中潰敗。
A single golden tress fell across her shoulder.
一綹金色的髮絲垂落在她的肩上。
The poem praised the long dark tresses of the princess.
這首詩讚美公主那一頭長長的黑髮。
The politician made an embarrassing gaffe during the interview.
那位政治人物在訪談中出了個令人尷尬的失言。
Calling her by the wrong name was a real gaffe.
把她的名字叫錯真是個大糗事。
The coach drew a new play in the team's playbook.
教練在球隊的戰術手冊裡畫了一套新戰術。
Startups often follow the same playbook to grow quickly.
新創公司常照著同一套方法快速成長。
By buying directly from the farm, you cut out the middleman.
直接向農場購買，就能省去中間商。
He acted as a middleman between the buyer and the seller.
他擔任買賣雙方之間的中間人。
His eyes were bloodshot after a night without sleep.
他一夜沒睡，眼睛布滿血絲。
Allergies left her eyes red and bloodshot.
過敏讓她的眼睛又紅又充血。
Some ads use subliminal messages to influence what you buy.
有些廣告用潛意識的訊息來影響你買什麼。
The music had a subliminal effect on how calm I felt.
這段音樂在潛移默化中影響了我平靜的感覺。
I had yogurt with granola and berries for breakfast.
我早餐吃了優格配燕麥脆片和莓果。
She packed a granola bar for the hike.
她為了健行帶了一條燕麥棒。
The shop sells hand-painted earthenware bowls.
這家店賣手繪的陶碗。
Ancient earthenware was found at the dig site.
考古現場出土了古代的陶器。
The saxophonist played a slow, warm song at the club.
薩克斯風手在俱樂部裡吹了一首緩慢溫暖的曲子。
My cousin dreams of becoming a famous saxophonist.
我表哥夢想成為有名的薩克斯風手。

retained.zh: 保留；留住（retain 的過去式）
ai: The old building retained its original charm after the repairs.
那棟老建築在整修後仍保留了原有的韻味。
He retained his title for a third year in a row.
他連續第三年保住了冠軍頭銜。
We had to scrounge around for firewood in the dark.
我們得在黑暗中到處搜尋柴火。
He tried to scrounge a few dollars from his friends.
他想向朋友們討一點錢。
The leaves of the plant have a smooth, waxy surface.
這種植物的葉子表面光滑如蠟。
The sick man's face looked pale and waxy.
病人的臉看起來蒼白如蠟。
The farmer cut the tall grass with a scythe.
農夫用長柄大鐮刀割長長的草。
In old stories, Death carries a scythe.
在古老的故事裡，死神拿著一把大鐮刀。
The school offers a course in intercultural communication.
學校開了一門跨文化溝通的課。
Living abroad gave her a lot of intercultural experience.
旅居國外讓她累積了許多跨文化的經驗。
The village holds a summer fete to raise money for the school.
村子每年夏天舉辦園遊會為學校籌款。
Children enjoyed games and cake at the fete.
孩子們在園遊會上玩遊戲、吃蛋糕，玩得很開心。
The town feted the returning team with a big parade.
全鎮用盛大的遊行來歡迎凱旋的球隊。
The writer was feted by critics after her book came out.
她的書出版後，這位作家受到評論家的盛讚。
He fixed the outboard motor on the small fishing boat.
他修理了小漁船上的舷外馬達。
The outboard engine was too loud for a quiet lake.
舷外引擎對安靜的湖來說太吵了。
The athlete was banned for doping.
那位運動員因為使用禁藥而被禁賽。
Strict tests have been introduced to fight doping in sports.
為了打擊運動中的禁藥問題，已引進嚴格的檢驗。
Prices have not risen appreciably this year.
今年物價並沒有明顯上漲。
The new engine is appreciably quieter than the old one.
新引擎明顯比舊的安靜。
The prim teacher always buttoned her blouse to the top.
那位拘謹的老師總是把襯衫扣到最上面一顆。
He gave a prim smile and said nothing.
他拘謹地微微一笑，什麼也沒說。
The roller coaster ride exhilarated the children.
坐雲霄飛車讓孩子們興奮不已。
The cold mountain air exhilarated her after the long climb.
爬了好久之後，山上冷冽的空氣讓她精神為之一振。
She wore a warm ribbed sweater to school.
她穿著一件保暖的羅紋毛衣去上學。
The socks have a ribbed top that stays up well.
這雙襪子有羅紋的襪口，不容易滑落。
The band's discordant notes hurt my ears.
樂團那些不和諧的音讓我耳朵很不舒服。
There were discordant voices in the committee about the plan.
委員會裡對這項計畫出現了不一致的聲音。
He was a pretender to the throne but never became king.
他是個覬覦王位的人，卻始終沒有當上國王。
The real expert quickly spotted the pretender in the group.
真正的專家很快就看出了這群人裡的冒牌貨。
The thief remained unrepentant even after the trial.
即使審判結束，那名小偷仍毫無悔意。
She was an unrepentant fan of old movies.
她是個毫不羞愧的老電影迷。

planted.zh: 種植；栽種（plant 的過去式）
ai: We planted tomatoes in the garden last spring.
去年春天我們在花園裡種了番茄。
My grandfather planted this tree when he was a boy.
我爺爺小時候種下了這棵樹。
Someone planted a false story in the newspaper.
有人在報紙上安插了一則假消息。
The suspect claimed that the police had planted the evidence.
嫌疑人聲稱證據是警方栽贓的。
He had the temerity to ask for a raise on his first day.
他居然膽大到第一天上班就要求加薪。
She was shocked by the temerity of the young stranger.
她對那位年輕陌生人的魯莽大膽感到震驚。

sharpened.zh: 磨利；削尖（sharpen 的過去式）
ai: He sharpened his pencil before the exam.
他在考試前把鉛筆削尖。
The chef sharpened the knife on a stone.
廚師在磨刀石上把刀磨利。
The lab uses distilled water for its experiments.
實驗室做實驗時使用蒸餾水。
Whiskey is a distilled spirit made from grain.
威士忌是用穀物製成的蒸餾酒。
She was a redoubtable debater who rarely lost an argument.
她是個令人敬畏的辯論高手，很少在爭論中落敗。
The team faced a redoubtable opponent in the final.
球隊在決賽中面對一個難纏的強敵。
The government announced the interdiction of illegal fishing in the bay.
政府宣布禁止在海灣非法捕魚。
The navy focused on the interdiction of drug shipments.
海軍把重點放在攔截毒品運輸。

redolent.zh: 散發著香味的；令人聯想到…的
ai: The kitchen was redolent of fresh bread and cinnamon.
廚房裡瀰漫著新鮮麵包和肉桂的香味。
The old photo album was redolent of childhood summers.
那本老相簿讓人想起童年的夏天。
The baby spat out the carrots and laughed.
寶寶把紅蘿蔔吐了出來，還咯咯笑。
He spat on the ground and walked away angrily.
他朝地上吐了口口水，憤怒地走開。
The couple had a small spat over dinner.
這對情侶晚餐時為了小事拌嘴。
A silly spat between friends is usually forgotten the next day.
朋友之間的無聊小爭執通常隔天就忘了。
Many returnees found it hard to adjust after years abroad.
許多歸國者在國外待了多年後覺得很難重新適應。
The government offers job training for returnees.
政府為歸國者提供就業訓練。
His plans for the future are still rather nebulous.
他對未來的計畫還相當模糊。
The idea was too nebulous to turn into a real project.
這個想法太含糊，無法變成實際的專案。

unreadable.zh: 難以辨認的；讀不下去的
ai: The doctor's handwriting is almost unreadable.
那位醫生的字跡幾乎無法辨認。
I found the long report dry and unreadable.
我覺得那份長篇報告枯燥乏味，根本讀不下去。
The workers complained about exploitative wages.
工人抱怨剝削式的薪資。
Critics called the contract exploitative and unfair.
批評者稱這份合約是剝削且不公平的。
The cost of the repair was not inconsiderable.
修理的費用可不是小數目。
He left behind an inconsiderable sum of money.
他留下的是微不足道的一點錢。
All our hard work came to naught.
我們所有的努力都化為烏有。
Their warnings counted for naught because nobody listened.
他們的警告一點用也沒有，因為沒人聽。
My grandmother has become forgetful in her old age.
我奶奶年紀大了變得健忘。
I am so forgetful that I leave my keys at home almost every week.
我很健忘，幾乎每週都會把鑰匙忘在家裡。
The king was only a figurehead with no real power.
國王只是個沒有實權的虛位元首。
The chairman is a figurehead, and the manager makes the decisions.
董事長只是個掛名的人，真正做決定的是經理。
The fox cunningly hid behind the bushes and waited.
狐狸狡猾地躲在灌木叢後等待。
The room was cunningly designed to look much bigger than it is.
這個房間被巧妙地設計，看起來比實際大很多。
